_comment: A squared infantry block under bow fire closes up over its casualties instead of renumbering every cell behind each fallen man. uid 0: 60 Infantry spawned in Square (formation 3: 8 files, 7 full ranks and a rear rank of 4, 9 wu pitch both ways) at (880, 540) facing north, with a morale floor of 50 under fire so it holds. uid 1: 50 Archers at (1310, 500) facing west, their reach stretched to 470 wu; they shoot into the square's east face. Volleys land at tick 272 (60 -> 58), 332 (58 -> 57), 392 and 452. slots_across_centreline and slot_lateral_excess are read from the full dump on the volley's own tick, before the men move (DemoDefects.derived_field). On the merge-base (b055ef7f) reap renumbers the square pairing (drop_slot_assignment), which sends each rank's first man to the far end of the rank ahead: at tick 272, 11 men have their slot across the square's centreline and the farthest slot lies 62.9 wu (7 pitches) sideways of its man, and the volley at tick 332 takes two men there, not one. Here none is sent across, and no slot lies more than 8.9 wu sideways (pinned at one file pitch plus a 0.5 wu float margin: a close-up moves a man at most one file sideways). The square's centre stays within 10.4 wu of where it stood through tick 600 here (farthest at tick 600: 7.0 wu west and 7.6 wu south, 10.34 wu); on the merge-base the men walking across the block drag it up to 37.2 wu off (tick 546), to x = 844.5 by tick 600. On the merge-base the dense dump also fails shape_residual (29.4 wu against 6.75) and misslotted (0.60 against 0.25) for uid 0; here both pass. all_teams_control and drill keep both sides under test control. On the merge-base every pin after tick 8 fails except the tick-272 headcount.
